biotools.summary: GloScope is a Bioconductor package for visualizing and summarizing single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-Seq) data at the population scale. It allows for the estimation of sample distributions, calculation of statistical divergence, and visualization of distance matrices using MDS plots.
